row.team_price_text: Starter: $10/mo helpdesk, 50 tickets, 3 seats (monthly billing only)
row.evidence: Gorgias documents only OIDC custom SSO ("Available on Advanced and Enterprise Helpdesk plans"); no SCIM endpoint appears in the pricing page, help-centre sitemap or developer API reference.
row.notes: No SCIM by absence (rule 5): pricing page, docs.gorgias.com sitemap (671 articles), developer llms.txt/API reference and Okta OIN search show no SCIM. Pricing is flat and ticket-based, not per agent: helpdesk Starter $10/mo (monthly only, 3 seats), Basic $50/mo ($600/yr), Pro $300/mo ($3,600/yr), Advanced $750/mo ($9,000/yr), custom plan via sales; AI Agent bundles cost more. Custom SSO is OIDC on Advanced and Enterprise per the help centre, while the pricing page lists "SSO (SAML)" under the custom plan. Google/Microsoft sign-in on all plans is social login. Auto-join lets users with approved domains create accounts via custom SSO. The REST API (users, teams, events) is on all plans.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Pricing compare table marks Audit logs on Pro and Advanced.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented anywhere; false is by absence (rule 5), not an explicit vendor statement.

auth.notes: Private apps use HTTP Basic with email and API key; public apps must use OAuth2.

capabilities.notes: Role is a required object on user creation; teams can be listed and managed (create/update/delete team operations appear in the reference).

audit_log_api.notes: Audit log events are exposed via /api/events with 12-month retention.

rate_limits.text: Leaky bucket: API key integrations 40 requests per 20 s, OAuth2 apps 80 per 20 s (Enterprise: 10 s window); pricing page shows 2 req/s on all plans, 4 req/s on custom.

limitations.text: Deleting a user is irreversible and unassigns their tickets and deletes their statistics.

fallbacks.notes: Auto-join: users with approved email domains can create an account by authenticating with custom SSO; they must confirm their email before access.
